description.value: A blast of concentrated wind streaks toward a creature of your choice within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 2d8 bludgeoning damage and if it is Large or smaller is knocked 10 feet away from you.\n\n

higher_level_description.value: When you cast this spell using a spell lot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each level above 1st.
